XppService._DataDirectoryNote: Omitted on purpose - service defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\dynamics-xpp\ at runtime so the cache survives builds and branch switches. Set this key to override.
XppService._BridgeExecutableNote: Omitted on purpose - the service discovers XppMetadataBridge.exe via BridgeExeResolver (env var XPP_BRIDGE_EXE > sibling > dev-tree walk for src/XppMetadataBridge/bin/{Release,Debug}/net48/). Set this key to an explicit absolute path to override discovery.
XppService._BridgePoolNote: The bridge pool is dynamically sized [Min, Max]. Defaults: Min=2 (kept warm for query latency), Max=max(2, ProcessorCount-1). Override here or in %LOCALAPPDATA%\dynamics-xpp\config.json via BridgePoolMin / BridgePoolMax / BridgePoolIdleSeconds. A single BridgePoolSize, if set, pins both bounds (static pool).

D365._Note: Intentionally EMPTY. The packages directory is discovered per machine and recorded in %LOCALAPPDATA%\dynamics-xpp\config.json by 'dt setup' (tools/D365Discovery.ps1), which overlays this file. A drive letter hardcoded here would be wrong on any box whose LCS deployment chose a different drive. Set these keys only to force a specific path.
